title: Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewaon Ke Pradan Ki Guarantee Adhiniyam, 2010
eligibility: All citizens domiciled in Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Guaranteed delivery of notified public services within stipulated time limits
Compensatory fine awarded to citizens for delayed service delivery
application_process: Step 1: Submit service request at Lok Sewa Kendra or online via MP e-District.
Step 2: Obtain acknowledgment receipt with fixed deadline date.
Step 3: File appeal before Appellate Authority if service is delayed or rejected.
important_sections_or_clauses: Section 4: Designated Officer must render service within fixed timeframe
Section 5: Right to file First Appeal within 30 days of rejection/delay
Section 7: Imposition of penalty up to ₹5,000 on defaulting officers
